verdict.rationale: Missive's docs clearly document snoozing a conversation until a specific time so it resurfaces in the Inbox, including quick access via swipe or command bar (missive-docs-supp-1, missive-docs-supp-2). However, there is no evidence of a distinct 'follow-up reminder' feature that resurfaces a thread specifically if nobody replies (as opposed to a fixed snooze time) — the story's reply-tracking trigger is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of a no-reply-triggered follow-up reminder mechanism, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of snooze/reminder reliability.
